sec.intro: Whether every part of the factory works, how people sign in, and the proof that the data can come back. Facts read now, not settings.
sec.later: Coming later: jobs and integrations with their runs, session lengths, the actions that ask for a fresh code, security events, and sign-in with Microsoft or Google.

noAccess.title: Not yours to open
noAccess.body: Security & health needs the right to see it (security.view). Ask an administrator of your company.

failed.title: This could not be read
failed.body: The answer did not arrive. The other sections keep working.

overall.partly: {ok} parts working · {unknown} not watched by Nexus yet
overall.unavailable: Status not available: nothing here says it all works.

status.title: Is everything working?
status.hint: A plain line per part, read now.
status.unavailableBody: The status could not be read, so nothing is shown as working. Try again in a moment.

api.ok: This page reached the API: it answers.

database.ok: The API read this page from the database.

scheduled.unknown: Nexus keeps no record of each scheduled run yet: a missed one is not shown here (the jobs list comes later).

backups.unknown: Backups are kept by the database provider; Nexus cannot read them yet. The second copy at another EU provider waits for the Owner's yes.

jobs.ok_one: 1 event waiting to be handled; none failed.
jobs.ok_other: {count} events waiting to be handled; none failed.
jobs.late_one: 1 event has waited {minutes} minutes: the worker may be stopped.
jobs.late_other: {count} events waiting, the oldest for {minutes} minutes: the worker may be stopped.
jobs.failing_one: 1 event failed for good: what it should have done did not happen.
jobs.failing_other: {count} events failed for good: what they should have done did not happen.

files.none: No file store is set up: uploads and documents cannot be kept.
files.paused: The file store is paused: no file can be read or kept.
files.live_one: The file store works; 1 file was held back in the last 30 days.
files.live_other: The file store works; {count} files were held back in the last 30 days.
files.test_one: Test mode: files stay on this machine; 1 file was held back in the last 30 days.
files.test_other: Test mode: files stay on this machine; {count} files were held back in the last 30 days.
files.liveClean: The file store works; no file was held back in the last 30 days.
files.testClean: Test mode: files stay on this machine; no file was held back in the last 30 days.

hint.inTransit: Every answer of the API tells browsers to use HTTPS only (HSTS).
hint.atRest: Done by the database and file providers; Nexus does not check it itself.
hint.secrets: Passwords of outside services and webhook keys are sealed one by one; {count} sealed now.
hint.bank: IBANs change only with a fresh code and are hidden from the floor and from customers; they are not sealed per field yet.
hint.headers: Strict headers on every answer: no framing, no guessing of content, same-origin isolation.
hint.virusScan: Uploads are not scanned yet: the scanner comes with the Owner's yes.

signIn.title: Sign-in rules
signIn.passwordRule: {min} to {max} characters, not a common one, not your name or email
signIn.lockoutRule: After {count} wrong tries in a row: locked {first} minute, doubling up to {max} minutes
signIn.sessionsRule: End after {idle} hours unused, at the latest after {days} days
signIn.stepUpRule: Risky changes ask for an authenticator code; it counts for {minutes} minutes
signIn.twoFactorRule: {asking} of {total} office roles ask for it
signIn.twoFactorWithout_one: 1 person whose role asks for it has not set it up yet: asked at their next sign-in.
signIn.twoFactorWithout_other: {count} people whose role asks for it have not set it up yet: asked at their next sign-in.
signIn.twoFactorAll: Everyone whose role asks for it has set it up.

tf.title: Two-factor per role
tf.hint: Tick roles, then ask for two-factor or stop asking. Tick every role to ask it of every office user.

since.unknown: Asked since before Nexus kept the date

lock.floor: A floor role: the tablet and the PIN are its factors
lock.money: Sees costs or margins: always asked
lock.template: The ready-made role always asks for it

held.right: Changing it needs the right to edit roles
held.mine: You hold this role: another administrator changes it

held.ask: Every ticked role asks for it already
held.stop: None of the ticked roles can stop asking

tf.nextSignIn: A change applies at each person's next sign-in, never in the middle of their work.

refusal.floor: A floor role never asks for two-factor: the tablet and the PIN are the floor's factors.
refusal.money: A role that sees costs or margins always asks for two-factor.
refusal.template: This ready-made role always asks for two-factor.
refusal.already: This role asks for two-factor already.
refusal.notAsked: This role does not ask for two-factor.
refusal.held: You hold this role: ask another administrator to change it.
refusal.stale: This role changed meanwhile: close and read the page again.
refusal.lockOut: Nobody could manage people and roles until they set up two-factor. First one administrator sets up two-factor on My profile, then ask it of this role.

dialog.askBody_one: 1 person has not set up two-factor yet: at their next sign-in they are asked to, before they can use the role.
dialog.askBody_other: {count} people have not set up two-factor yet: at their next sign-in they are asked to, before they can use the role.
dialog.stopBody_one: 1 person will no longer be asked for a code by this role.
dialog.stopBody_other: {count} people will no longer be asked for a code by these roles.
dialog.openSessions_one: 1 session open now keeps the role until it ends (at most 7 days); suspend the person to stop it at once.
dialog.openSessions_other: {count} sessions open now keep the role until they end (at most 7 days); suspend a person to stop theirs at once.
dialog.stopWarn: Someone who steals a password could then use these roles without the phone.
dialog.someone: A person (names need the right to see users)
dialog.reasonHint: Kept in the audit log with the change.
dialog.code: Saving asks for a fresh code from your authenticator.
dialog.refused: Fix what is not possible first
dialog.previewFailed: Who it affects could not be read. Close and try again.

backups.title: Backups and restore drills
backups.hint: Proof the data can come back.
backups.recoveryHint: Any minute of the last days can be restored by the provider; Nexus does not read its window yet.
backups.secondCopy: Daily copy at a second EU provider
backups.secondCopyHint: Waits for the Owner's yes to the off-site storage.
backups.filesHint: A second copy of every file comes in a later wave.

drill.recordHeld: Recording a drill needs the right to record restore drills.
drill.emptyBody: Restore a backup somewhere other than production, then record what it showed with Record a restore drill.

state.none: No restore drill recorded yet: nobody has proved a backup comes back.
state.ok: Last drill {ago} days ago — due in {left} days.
state.dueSoon: Last drill {ago} days ago — due in {left} days.
state.overdue: Overdue by {left} days: the last drill passed {ago} days ago.
state.failed: The last drill failed ({day}): find out why, then drill again.

dialog.title: Record a restore drill
dialog.hint: A backup you restored somewhere other than production, and what its records showed.

field.environmentHint: Where you restored it: a local copy, staging. Never production.
field.backupAtHint: The time of the backup you restored.
field.durationHint: How long the restore took: the recovery time it proves.
field.restoredHint: On the restored copy open Security & health, read its fingerprint at the backup's time and paste the line here.
field.evidenceHint: The restore log or a screenshot; kept with the drill.
field.evidenceTypes: PDF, image, text or CSV, up to 25 MB

compare.title: This database beside the restored copy
compare.needBackup: Choose the backup's time to compare.
compare.needLine: Paste the restored copy's fingerprint line to compare.
compare.failed: This database's fingerprint could not be read. Close and try again.

error.environment: Say where the backup was restored.
error.production: A drill restores somewhere other than production, never over it.
error.backupLater: The backup is from before the day of the drill, and not from the future.
error.future: The day of the drill cannot be in the future.
error.restoredEmpty: Paste the restored copy's fingerprint line.
error.restored: This is not a whole fingerprint line: copy it again from the restored copy.

print.title: This database's fingerprint
print.hint: On a restored copy, read the fingerprint at the backup's time and copy the line into Record a restore drill on the real system. Checksums of record ids only: no money, no names.
print.failed: The fingerprint could not be read.

notice.drillPassed: Restore drill recorded: it passed. The next one is due in 90 days.
notice.drillFailed: Restore drill recorded: it failed. Find out why, then drill again.
notice.asked_one: Two-factor is asked of 1 role from each person's next sign-in.
notice.asked_other: Two-factor is asked of {count} roles from each person's next sign-in.
notice.stopped_one: 1 role no longer asks for two-factor.
notice.stopped_other: {count} roles no longer ask for two-factor.
notice.copyFailed: The line could not be copied: select it and copy it by hand.

problem.invalid: Something in the drill is not right: check the fields.
problem.conflict: Something changed meanwhile: close and read the page again.
problem.forbidden: You may not do this here.
problem.failed: It could not be saved. Try again.

attention.title: Needs attention
attention.hint: Set-up facts that went wrong since, in one place.
attention.unread_one: 1 kind of fact is not yours to read and is left out.
attention.unread_other: {count} kinds of facts are not yours to read and are left out.

kind.mailDomain: Mail domain {subject}: its records are not confirmed yet
kind.tabletNever: Tablet {subject} never seen since it was enrolled
kind.twoFactorMissing_one: 1 person whose role asks for two-factor has not set it up
kind.twoFactorMissing_other: {count} people whose role asks for two-factor have not set it up

role.title: Two-factor
role.hint: Ask for two-factor of this role: its people give a code from their phone when they sign in.
role.membersNone: Everyone who holds this role has set up two-factor.
role.membersHidden_one: 1 person has not set it up (names need the right to see users).
role.membersHidden_other: {count} people have not set it up (names need the right to see users).
role.changeHeld: Changing it needs the right to edit roles
role.readFailed: This role's two-factor rule could not be read.
